convergent.label: Regime Change Dynamics
convergent.description: Multiple disciplines acknowledge regime change as either an explicit Western objective (Ctr-Right) or unintended consequence of military intervention (Left/Ctr-Left), though motivations differ between punitive containment vs. democratic aspirations.

convergent.label: Economic Collapse & Military Prioritization
convergent.description: Left and Ctr-Right concur that Iran's economic freefall stems from prioritizing military/proxy expenditures over public welfare, though Left blames imperialism while Ctr-Right emphasizes regime mismanagement.

convergent.label: Civilian Impact of Strikes
convergent.description: Center-Left, Center, and Ctr-Right all document civilian casualties from military operations but frame them differently: as humanitarian failures (Ctr-Left), collateral damage (Center), or regime propaganda tools (Ctr-Right).

contradictory.label: Intervention Efficacy
contradictory.description: Left rejects military action as imperialist escalation harming civilians, while Center frames strikes as necessary security measures enabling diplomatic leverage against nuclear threats.

contradictory.label: Regime Resilience Assessment
contradictory.description: Ctr-Right emphasizes regime fragility from war/economic strain, whereas Right asserts Iran's rapid military reconstitution proves enduring threat capacity despite setbacks.

emergent.label: Coercion Paradox
emergent.description: Cross-analysis reveals military pressure and sanctions intended to weaken the regime instead consolidate elite cohesion by justifying repression and diverting resources to security apparatuses, per Left economic critiques and Ctr-Right survivalism.

emergent.label: Proxy War Feedback Loop
emergent.description: Integration shows how Iran's regional proxies (emphasized by Right/Ctr-Right) both extend its influence and deepen economic isolation (noted by Left/Ctr-Left), creating self-reinforcing cycles of external confrontation and internal deprivation.

emergent.label: Narrative Weaponization
emergent.description: Synthesis exposes how all factions instrumentalize civilian suffering - Left as imperialist brutality, Center as regrettable necessity, Right as regime manipulation - revealing shared rhetorical reliance on victimhood despite divergent policy prescriptions.
